source_name: Foran Lenzen Dey 2005 Balancing Act Vol 1-2
notes: CSIRO / University of Sydney. Triple Bottom Line analysis of Australian economy. Gold & Lead sector (13140010+13170010) provides peer-reviewed TBL benchmarks for Phase 1 (mining) and Phase 2 (processing). Jurisdiction: Australia. Data reference year: 2002-2003.

World's largest gold mining company by production. 2024 annual sustainability report covering global operations (Americas, Africa, Australia, Pacific). Data verified by third-party auditors. Provides real operational metrics for Phase 1 (mining) and Phase 2 (ore processing) including water recycling, cyanide management, land reclamation, LBMA compliance, and supplier due diligence.
